prompt: Our kitchen fridge in Bordeaux is completely covered ___ our children's drawings.
explanation_ru: Глагол cover в значении состояния (покрыт чем-то) требует предлога with (или in), но не by.

prompt: By the end of the Edinburgh street show, my hat was filled ___ coins and a spare theatre ticket.
explanation_ru: После filled (наполнен чем-то) всегда используется предлог with.

prompt: On my uncle's Welsh farm, the sheep are counted ___ a machine every morning.
explanation_ru: Машина здесь выступает как исполнитель действия, поэтому by.

prompt: At the hospital, bags of dirty clothes are tied ___ a special string that melts in cold water.
explanation_ru: Специальная верёвка — это материал/инструмент, с помощью которого завязывают мешки, поэтому нужен предлог with.

prompt: Isn't the text on the TV screen controlled ___ a button under the desk?
explanation_ru: Кнопка — механизм, управляющий текстом, поэтому by.

prompt: That tiny corner shop in Belfast has been run ___ the same family for three generations.
explanation_ru: Семья — это люди, которые управляют магазином (исполнитель действия), поэтому нужен предлог by.

prompt: The brass handle on our Bristol museum generator was worn down ___ thousands of enthusiastic school fingers.
explanation_ru: Здесь указана причина/источник износа, поэтому используется предлог by.

prompt: Two hundred years of old ship diaries were copied ___ online volunteers to study old weather patterns.
explanation_ru: Волонтёры — исполнители действия (кто расшифровал журналы), поэтому требуется предлог by.

prompt: Every parcel of diamonds left in the safe overnight is covered ___ invisible powder.
explanation_ru: Порошок — это вещество, которым покрывают посылку: covered with.

prompt: To make a sunny Oxfordshire village look like Christmas, paper snow flakes are wetted down ___ a fine mist.
explanation_ru: Мелкая водяная пыль — средство, с помощью которого смачивают бумагу, поэтому используется with.

prompt: Thirty-two thousand pieces of armour in the Graz museum are covered ___ oil every second winter to prevent rust.
explanation_ru: Масло — вещество, которым покрывают доспехи: covered with.

prompt: After 1980s cassette audio is fed into a modern soundcard, any signal dropouts are cleaned up ___ a custom script.
explanation_ru: Скрипт здесь выступает как инструмент, которым пользуется инженер (with a script).

prompt: The ancient Cairo curator was surprised ___ a single grain of barley stuck in the paint of the wooden boat.
explanation_ru: После surprised используется предлог by (или at), но не with.

prompt: Three new species of Yunnan primrose were identified ___ a plant geneticist who sequenced DNA from dry 1922 stems.
explanation_ru: Генетик — исполнитель действия (кто определил виды), и это важная новая информация, поэтому нужен предлог by.

prompt: Oak timbers raised from the Solent seabed were sprayed continuously ___ cold water and wax for nineteen years.
explanation_ru: Вода и воск — вещества, которыми опрыскивали древесину (sprayed with).

prompt: Why were the Borneo documentary hides hoisted forty metres into the canopy ___ climbing ropes two months early?
explanation_ru: Альпинистские верёвки — инструмент, с помощью которого поднимали укрытия (with ropes).

prompt: Before a big dinosaur skeleton is moved onto a truck, the old bones are wrapped in cloth soaked ___ plaster.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое управление глагола soak — soaked in (пропитанный чем-то).

prompt: A fragile Fair Isle jumper found in a peat-cutter's trunk was copied stitch by stitch ___ local Shetland knitters.
explanation_ru: Местные вязальщицы — исполнители действия, поэтому используется предлог by.

prompt: We organised a secret farewell card for our manager in Leeds. It was passed round the whole office and signed (preposition) everyone. We weren't worried (preposition) her finding out, until she accidentally signed it herself!
explanation_ru: Signed by everyone — указание исполнителей действия. Worried about — устойчивое управление прилагательного.

prompt: A huge parcel arrived at our Bristol front door this morning. It was addressed to us, so I opened it (preposition) a pair of kitchen scissors. Inside, the box was filled (preposition) twenty kilos of dog food — and we don't even have a dog!
explanation_ru: В первом случае ножницы — инструмент (with scissors), во втором — устойчивое выражение filled with.

prompt: I tried on a brand-new jacket in a Paris department store today. When I reached into the pocket, I found a train ticket and a shopping list written (preposition) pencil. Clearly, it had been left there (preposition) a previous shopper.
explanation_ru: Written in pencil — устойчивое выражение для материала письма (допустимо with a pencil, но без артикля чаще in). Left by a shopper — исполнитель действия.

prompt: Museum staff in Vienna avoid using strong chemicals on old stuffed animals. Every five years, the glass cases are frozen to minus thirty degrees inside a big room. That way, any insects are killed (preposition) the extreme cold rather than (preposition) poison.
explanation_ru: Холод — природная причина (killed by the cold), а спреи — средство/инструмент (with sprays).

prompt: Engineers in Zurich recently tested a four-legged climbing robot on a wet stone wall. Halfway up, its safety rope was pulled sharply (preposition) a student researcher. The team were impressed (preposition) how calmly the machine re-attached its feet.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске исследователь — исполнитель действия (by). Во втором — управление impressed by/with.

prompt: Making metal statues at the Glasgow art college is fascinating to watch. First, the hollow clay shell is heated in an oven until the wax model melts out. Next, the empty mould is filled (preposition) hot liquid bronze, which is poured carefully (preposition) a skilled worker.
explanation_ru: Filled with — устойчивое управление для наполнения веществом. Poured by a technician — указание исполнителя.

prompt: In our Kent garden, apples that fall to the ground are sent to make juice by people.
answer: In our Kent garden, apples that fall to the ground are sent to make juice.
accepted_answers: In our Kent garden, apples that fall to the ground are sent to make juice.
explanation_ru: Добавление by people не несёт никакой новой информации и звучит неестественно в пассиве — его нужно убрать.

prompt: At seven a.m., every Coventry ambulance bag is checked against a list before the shift begins.
answer: At seven a.m., every Coventry ambulance bag is checked against a list before the shift begins.
accepted_answers: At seven a.m., every Coventry ambulance bag is checked against a list before the shift begins.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет. Исполнитель (парамедики) понятен из контекста, поэтому его правильно опустили.

prompt: Waste heat from the Luleå server farm is piped under the streets by someone to warm three thousand flats.
answer: Waste heat from the Luleå server farm is piped under the streets to warm three thousand flats.
accepted_answers: Waste heat from the Luleå server farm is piped under the streets to warm three thousand flats.
explanation_ru: Указание by someone в описании технического процесса бессмысленно и должно быть опущено.

prompt: To stop two hundred Besançon clocks chiming at once, the striking trains are wound half an hour apart with the curator.
answer: To stop two hundred Besançon clocks chiming at once, the striking trains are wound half an hour apart by the curator.
accepted_answers: To stop two hundred Besançon clocks chiming at once, the striking trains are wound half an hour apart by the curator.
explanation_ru: Куратор — человек, выполняющий действие (агент), поэтому используется предлог by, а не with.

prompt: During the November full moon on Heron Island, nets are tied over the coral in the evening by people.
answer: During the November full moon on Heron Island, nets are tied over the coral in the evening.
accepted_answers: During the November full moon on Heron Island, nets are tied over the coral in the evening.
explanation_ru: В описании научного процесса by people — лишнее и неестественное дополнение.

prompt: A local news article mentions how many bikes are pulled out of Amsterdam's canals each year. It does not matter who pulls them out. Which sentence sounds most natural?
options: About fifteen thousand bicycles are fished out of the canals every year by someone.
About fifteen thousand bicycles are fished out of the canals every year.
About fifteen thousand bicycles are fished out of the canals with people every year.
Someone is fishing out about fifteen thousand bicycles every year.
explanation_ru: В новостях, когда исполнитель не важен, пассив используется без by someone.

prompt: A PhD student in Uppsala found an uncatalogued Viking comb in a shoebox. Nobody knows who put it there decades ago. Which sentence fits a news report best?
options: The Viking comb had been placed in a shoebox labelled 'misc. bones' by somebody.
The Viking comb had been placed in a shoebox labelled 'misc. bones'.
The Viking comb had been placed in a shoebox with somebody.
Somebody had placed the Viking comb in a shoebox by hand.
explanation_ru: Если исполнитель неизвестен, в пассивной конструкции by somebody не добавляется.

prompt: A York theatre posts backstage closing instructions. Every night at midnight, a single bare bulb on a stand (the ghost light) must be moved to the centre of the stage. Which sentence fits a formal notice?
options: The ghost light must be wheeled onto the centre of the stage by people before locking up.
The ghost light must be wheeled onto the centre of the stage before locking up.
The ghost light must be wheeled onto the centre of the stage with a technician.
People must wheel the ghost light by the stage before locking up.
explanation_ru: В официальных инструкциях и объявлениях исполнитель (by people) опускается, так как важно само действие.

prompt: A seventeenth-century book of maps was stolen from a Lund library in 1998. Twelve years later, a sharp-eyed expert recognised it by a small hole on page 44. Which sentence highlights the expert naturally?
options: The stolen book was spotted at a New York sale with a sharp-eyed expert.
The stolen book was spotted at a New York sale by a sharp-eyed expert.
The stolen book was spotted at a New York sale by someone.
The stolen book spotted a sharp-eyed expert at a New York sale.
explanation_ru: Когда исполнитель несёт важную новую информацию (a sharp-eyed expert), он вводится предлогом by.

prompt: You are writing a review of the Brussels musical-instrument museum. When you step in front of a case, your infrared headphones automatically play a recording of that instrument. Which sentence sounds best?
options: An archival recording of the harpsichord is triggered in your ears by somebody.
An archival recording of the harpsichord is triggered in your ears automatically.
An archival recording of the harpsichord is triggered with infrared headphones by people.
Somebody triggers an archival recording of the harpsichord in your ears.
explanation_ru: Запись запускается автоматически системой, поэтому добавлять by somebody или by people — ошибка.

prompt: A film magazine explains how a Wellington studio makes a miniature castle collapse realistically on screen. The exact cameraman is unimportant. Which sentence fits the article?
options: The collapsing stonework is filmed at 120 frames a second and played back at 24.
The collapsing stonework is filmed at 120 frames a second by people.
The collapsing stonework is filmed by a camera at 120 frames a second by someone.
Someone films the collapsing stonework with 120 frames a second.
explanation_ru: В описании технологического процесса в пассиве лишние агенты (by people / by someone) опускаются.
